# What's new in 0.3.4

Released **2026-10-03**. Full project history: [CHANGELOG.md](../../CHANGELOG.md).

## Highlights

- **Saved rides.** When you Stop a ride (Real KICKR or Emulator), steadyGrind writes a FIT activity file.
- Home **Saved rides** lists date, time, length, and average watts. Download the FIT or Delete the entry — no detail view.
- Empty or sub-second Stop does not create a ride.
- Home section spacing is even between Today/Manual, Library, and Saved rides.

## Installer

- `steadyGrind-0.3.4-macos.dmg` (this folder)
- GitHub Release: https://github.com/attilameget/HomeWlanTrainer/releases/tag/v0.3.4
